card.title: Official Interpreter
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the final authority on what the impossible situation means, correcting every interpretation that threatens your version of reality.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our doorway opens to yesterday. It's an extension, not a fault.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday's me is coming through to complain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first visitor. Please make our extension welcoming.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says this is his house and we're the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He's confusing age with ownership. Show him today's mortgage payment; visiting hours end at six.

mechanism: A insists that a doorway to yesterday is a useful extension and treats the past self as a guest despite the ownership challenge.
confusable: Unlike simply improvising within time travel, A must correct interpretations that threaten the declared guest-and-extension reality.
comparison: The doorway alternative uses contested ownership and hospitality; the wardrobe alternative reframes movement and rent under freedom.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
